intro: Seeking an explosive countermeasure against the Venture Company's logging machines in the Stonetalon Mountains, Alliance adventurers are sent across the sea to Ironforge. There, the eccentric gnome Lomac Gearstrip agrees to brew his volatile invention, Nitromirglyceronium, provided you fetch the necessary alchemical reagents.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hahaha... You need Nitromirglyceronium to stop goblins from destroying a forest?!
I don't care if you know Gaxim or not... I'll give you the stuff just to see you or them explode into itty bitty pieces.
There's a problem though: I'm all out.
But I'll tell you what, you bring me the correct potions, and I'll make some up for you right away.
The least you can do is prove you've got some skill as an alchemist before I just give you a sample of my greatest creation.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I can't make any Nitromirglyceronium if I don't have the potions... They're vital to its creation.

clips.title: Completion
paras: If I didn't know better, stranger, I'd say you knew somethin' about alchemy. Good, good... The world's not all about swords and sorcery, you know?
